recommendedTextbook.title: New School Physics for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: M. W. Anyakoha
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Electric Charges, Coulomb's Law and Electric Fields
subtopics: Coulomb's inverse square law: F = kq1q2 / r²
Capacitance, parallel plate capacitors, and dielectrics
objectives: State Coulomb's law mathematically and in words
Calculate electric field strength due to isolated point charges
Determine equivalent capacitance in series and parallel circuits

subtopics: Magnetic field patterns around current-carrying conductors
Faraday's and Lenz's laws of electromagnetic induction
Electric generators, step-up and step-down transformers
objectives: State Faraday's law of induction and Lenz's law of opposing flux
Explain operating mechanism of dynamos and AC alternators
Calculate transformer efficiency and secondary voltage (Vs/Vp = Ns/Np)

subtopics: AC through resistors, inductors and capacitors (RLC circuits)
Resonance frequency in series RLC circuits: f = 1 / (2π√LC)
objectives: Draw phasor diagrams showing phase lead and lag
Calculate inductive reactance, capacitive reactance and circuit impedance

subtopics: Photoelectric effect and Einstein's photoelectric equation (hf = W0 + Kmax)
Bohr's model of the atom and hydrogen emission spectrum
Wave-particle duality and de Broglie wavelength
objectives: Explain threshold frequency and work function in photoelectric emission
Solve problems using Einstein's photoelectric equation
Calculate de Broglie wavelength of moving subatomic particles
